findings.claim: The validator can issue a passing verdict without running the blocking `make lint` constraint.
findings.evidence: Diff says: `make lint` is blocking, but then allows `report LINT: PENDING-CI` and `Give the verdict PASS (lint pending CI) only when everything else passed`; constraint `golangci-lint-clean` is blocking and says `command: 'make lint'`.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not allow PASS or archive when `make lint` cannot be run; return BLOCK/PENDING until `make lint` exits 0 or CI evidence is available before archive.

findings.claim: The tech lead is instructed to archive changes even when the blocking lint constraint is still pending.
findings.evidence: Diff says: `A PASS (lint pending CI) from the validator allows archive`; constraint `golangci-lint-clean` is under `Blocking Constraints (prevent archiving until resolved)` and requires `make lint`.
findings.suggested_fix: Require a real successful `make lint` result, or documented green CI lint result, before archive.

findings.claim: The license-header check is weaker than the blocking constraint and can pass Go files that do not start with the required WSO2 Apache header.
findings.evidence: Diff uses `grep -L 'Apache License' $(git ls-files '*.go')` and only requires it to print nothing; constraint `license-header` says `Every .go file starts with the WSO2 Apache 2.0 license header` and uses `grep -L 'Licensed under the Apache License\|Apache License,' $(git ls-files '*.go')`.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the project constraint check verbatim, and add a start-of-file/header validation if the gate must enforce `starts with` rather than merely containing the phrase anywhere.

findings.claim: The tech lead calls `make build` a read-only target even though the new reviewer/validator instructions say it writes `./fhir-server` into the repo.
findings.evidence: Diff says in fhir-tech-lead: `Use Bash only for ... the read-only make targets (build, vet, test)`; diff says in fhir-conformance-validator: `Never run make build (it writes ./fhir-server into the repo)` and in fhir-code-reviewer: `never run make build (it writes a binary into the repo)`.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `build` from the read-only make target list or instruct the agent to use `go build ./...` when it must avoid repository writes.
